trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Branch Manager (Channel Manager: Sales and Service)
Company: Absa Group
About the company: With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.
Purpose of the role: We are seeking a highly motivated Branch Manager to lead a complex branch and multiple service points within a strategically important market. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant business area, lead high-performing teams, drive commercial growth, champion digital innovation, and become a respected leader within your community. While traditionally known as a Branch Manager, this role is now referred to as a Channel Manager: Sales and Service within Absa. As a Channel Manager: Sales and Service you will be responsible for delivering sustainable business growth, exceptional customer experience, strong governance, and operational excellence, while developing future leaders and advancing the bank's transformation agenda. We are seeking an experienced Channel Manager: Sales and Service to lead a customer-facing sales and service operation, driving business growth, operational excellence, and client-centric outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially astute leader who thrives in a fast-paced, regulated financial services environment and is passionate about developing people, strengthening client relationships, and achieving outstanding business results.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Lead nodal operations with accountability for people, process, and performance.
  - Drive commercial growth and service excellence across multiple (SSO’s)
  - Oversee DHA, MVNO functions, ensuring efficient verification and ID smart card issuing.
  - Strengthen compliance and operational integrity in civic services.
  - Inspire and empower teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.
  - Expand market presence through oversight of RIB and External sales.
  - Harness technology to optimize efficiency and innovation.
  - Build resilient, high-performing teams aligned to strategic goals.
  - Ensure delivery of all performance targets with commercial focus.
  - Champion operational leadership that advances Africa’s service landscape.
  - Translate regional and national strategy into branch execution
  - Drive transformation, digital adoption, and inclusion initiatives
  - Position the branch as a trusted financial partner in the community
  - Full Branch P&L accountability (where applicable)
  - Deliver growth, profitability, and productivity targets
  - Optimise multi-channel and integrated service models
  - Lead senior branch leadership and management teams
  - Build a leadership pipeline and succession plans
  - Foster ethical leadership, engagement, and accountability
  - Overall accountability for branch risk, conduct, and regulatory compliance
  - Manage audits, governance forums, and material risk events
  - Ensure strong control environments and TCF adherence
  - Engage key clients, community structures, and external partners
  - Act as a brand ambassador for the bank
  - Deliver a consistently exceptional in-branch customer experience by proactively welcoming, guiding, and supporting customers
  - Promote efficient service, alternative banking channels
  - Upholding Absa’s service standards, image, and brand in a safe, professional, and well‑managed branch environment
Must-have requirements:
  - Bachelor`s Degrees and Advanced Diplomas: Banking
  - Bachelor`s Degrees and Advanced Diplomas: Business Administration
Location: Lydenburg
Work mode: onsite
Employment equity statement: Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
Accessibility statement: We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Branch Manager (Channel Manager: Sales and Service)

Absa Group

Lydenburg · onsite

About us
With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.

About the role
You will lead a complex branch and multiple service points in a strategically important market. At Absa this role is called Channel Manager: Sales and Service. You will own business growth, customer experience, governance and operational excellence, while developing future leaders and advancing the bank's transformation agenda.

Your team
You will lead senior branch leadership and management teams across the branch and its service points.

What you'll do
• Lead nodal operations with accountability for people, process and performance.
• Drive commercial growth and service excellence across multiple service points (SSOs).
• Oversee DHA and MVNO functions, ensuring efficient verification and ID smart card issuing.
• Strengthen compliance and operational integrity in civic services.
• Expand market presence through oversight of RIB and external sales.
• Translate regional and national strategy into branch execution.
• Carry full branch P&L accountability (where applicable) and deliver growth, profitability and productivity targets.
• Optimise multi-channel and integrated service models, and use technology to improve efficiency and innovation.
• Lead senior branch leadership and management teams, and build a leadership pipeline and succession plans.
• Foster ethical leadership, engagement and accountability, and build teams aligned to strategic goals.
• Take overall accountability for branch risk, conduct and regulatory compliance, including audits, governance forums and material risk events.
• Maintain strong control environments and Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) adherence.
• Engage key clients, community structures and external partners, and act as a brand ambassador for the bank.
• Deliver a consistently exceptional in-branch customer experience by proactively welcoming, guiding and supporting customers.
• Promote efficient service and alternative banking channels, and drive digital adoption, transformation and inclusion initiatives.
• Uphold Absa's service standards, image and brand in a safe, professional and well-managed branch environment.

What you need
• A Bachelor's Degree or Advanced Diploma in Banking, or in Business Administration.
• Experience leading a customer-facing sales and service operation, needed because you will be accountable for people, process and performance across a branch and multiple service points.
• Commercial judgement to deliver growth, profitability and productivity targets, including branch P&L accountability where applicable.
• Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, needed because you carry accountability for branch risk, conduct and regulatory compliance.
• Experience developing people and building leadership pipelines and succession plans.

Nice to have
• Exposure to DHA and MVNO functions, including verification and ID smart card issuing.
• Experience with multi-channel and integrated service models and digital adoption.

We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.

Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
